answer: Open pipeline went from EUR 179,000 at last week's freeze to EUR 164,500, down EUR 14,500, and two deals account for all of it. Vorort Systeme Ausbau was repriced down by EUR 5,000, from EUR 31,000 to EUR 26,000. valantic Migrationsprojekt (EUR 9,500) left the quarter: its close date moved to February, so it is no longer in this quarter's open number. Nothing was lost or won.
